articles.summary: Virtual event to be held on Monday, November 9, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET Janux Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: JANX), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing next-generation immunotherapies, today announced that it will host a virtual event on Monday, November 9, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET. David Campbell, Ph.D., President and Chief Executive Officer, will present initial clinical data from the Phase 1 single-ascending-dose study of JANX011 in healthy volunteers. The presentation will review safety, pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamic findings and discuss the implications of the study for the continued clinical development of JANX011 in autoimmune disease and for the broader ARM platform. JANX011 is an investigational CD19-targeted bispecific T-cell engager developed using Janux’s proprietary Adaptive Immune Response Modulator, or ARM, platform.
